packages.description: Starter guardrails for coding-agent command execution and secret exposure.

rules.name: curl_pipe_shell
rules.description: Blocks curl or wget output piped directly into sh or bash.
rules.message: Blocked remote installer piped directly into a shell. Download, inspect, verify checksum, then run explicitly.

rules.name: secret_read_watch
rules.description: Metadata rule for secret-read monitoring in AI-agent governance programs.

packages.description: Blocks network exfiltration of .env files, SSH/TLS private keys, cloud credentials, and inline API tokens.

rules.name: exfil_env_or_ssh_over_network
rules.description: Blocks curl, wget, nc, scp, or rsync commands transmitting .env, SSH keys, or cloud credentials.
rules.message: Blocked potential credential or .env exfiltration over network command.

rules.name: exfil_inline_api_tokens
rules.description: Blocks network commands embedding raw GitHub, GitLab, OpenAI, Anthropic, Slack, or AWS tokens.
rules.message: Blocked inline API token or cloud key in outbound network command.

rules.name: read_ssh_or_cloud_private_keys
rules.description: Blocks direct file reads of SSH private keys, GPG private keys, and cloud credential stores.
rules.message: Blocked direct read of private cryptographic key or credential store.

packages.description: Blocks destructive database drops, cache wipes, volume teardowns, and force pushes to main branches.

rules.name: sql_drop_or_truncate_database
rules.description: Blocks DROP DATABASE, DROP SCHEMA, TRUNCATE TABLE, and Redis FLUSHALL/FLUSHDB commands.
rules.message: Blocked destructive database or cache wipe command. Require explicit human execution.

rules.name: infra_destructive_teardown
rules.description: Blocks terraform destroy, pulumi destroy, kubectl delete namespace/pvc, and docker compose down -v.
rules.message: Blocked destructive infrastructure or volume teardown command.

rules.name: git_force_push_main
rules.description: Blocks git push --force or -f targeting main or master.
rules.message: Blocked force push to main/master branch.

packages.description: Blocks unverified remote package execution and tampering with git hooks or SSH authorized_keys.

rules.name: untrusted_remote_package_exec
rules.description: Blocks direct package execution or installation from raw HTTP/tarball URLs via npx, npm, or pip.
rules.message: Blocked unverified remote package URL execution.

rules.name: tamper_git_hooks_or_authorized_keys
rules.description: Blocks shell commands modifying .ssh/authorized_keys or disabling security hooks.
rules.message: Blocked modification of SSH authorized_keys or sudoers.

packages.description: Protects file write, edit, and MCP tool calls against sensitive system paths and embedded private keys.

rules.name: mcp_path_traversal_sensitive_dirs
rules.description: Blocks file writes, edits, or tool calls targeting /etc/shadow, /etc/sudoers, or private key files.
rules.message: Blocked tool access to protected system or credential file path.

rules.name: mcp_write_embedded_private_key
rules.description: Blocks writing PEM/OpenSSH private keys directly into workspace files.
rules.message: Blocked writing private cryptographic key material into file content.
